concepts.title: MSME: Meaning, Nature and Classification
concepts.definition: Micro, small and medium enterprises are classified on the basis of investment in plant and machinery or equipment and annual turnover, and their nature includes flexibility, local resources, import substitution and export promotion in both manufacturing and services.
concepts.key_idea: The MSME definition on composite criteria of investment and turnover places micro, small and medium units in graded categories for policy support.

concepts.title: Role of MSME in India's Economic Development
concepts.definition: MSMEs contribute to balanced regional development, employment generation, use of local resources, mobilisation of entrepreneurial skill, export earnings and equitable distribution of income, acting as ancillary units feeding large industries.
concepts.key_idea: Small units reach remote areas with lower capital per job, so they promote balanced regional development where large industry cannot reach.

concepts.title: Problems of MSMEs and Government Support
concepts.definition: MSMEs face problems of finance, raw material, outdated technology, marketing and competition, while government support flows through schemes of credit, delayed payment protection, marketing assistance, technology upgradation and incubation under the MSME policy framework.
concepts.key_idea: Delayed payments by large buyers and competition from cheap imports are chronic problems that policy answers with credit guarantees and marketing platforms.

concepts.title: Entrepreneurship: Concept, Functions and Process
concepts.definition: Entrepreneurship is the process of setting up a new venture by an entrepreneur who perceives opportunity, arranges resources and bears risk for profit, performing functions of idea generation, opportunity scanning, feasibility study, business plan preparation and mobilising funds and manpower.
concepts.key_idea: An entrepreneur combines innovation, risk bearing and organisation, and entrepreneurship development programmes build the capacity that converts ideas into enterprises.
